selection_contract.component_choice: Largest positive-area connected polygon; tie-break lexicographic bounds then normalized WKB.

selection_contract.no_optimization: One construction, no alternative centers, retries, family ranking, object-count minimization or minimum-set claim.
selection_contract.nonreleasable: Any intersecting fixed-pad/drill constraint aborts this proposal. Do not select a fallback square.
selection_contract.postcondition: Check every retained guarded upper polygon is disjoint from chosen square. This is only a conditional saved pad-obstacle certificate after hypothetical roster reconstruction, not full clearance, placement, replacement-route or connectivity feasibility.

selection_contract.subregion: Axis-aligned closed square at center, half-side min(0.25mm,r/4). Require positive area and strict containment in saved available polygon. This is a proposal offset interval, not qualified process tolerance.
